content:
Ian: Heads up — saw a 3.2x egress spike on last billing cycle. Cost Explorer shows ~$12k tagged as cross-region S3 GETs (eu-west-1 -> us-east-1) billed to prod-inference.

Maria: Yikes. Can you attach the Cost Explorer filter or a quick query? need to tag to chargebacks. :eyes:

Ian: Quick Cost Explorer export: account=prod, service=S3, usage_type=DataTransfer-Out-Bytes, linked_account=infra, region_from=eu-west-1, region_to=us-east-1. Most hits are labelled as S3:GetObject.

Todd: I ran an Athena query over S3 access logs for the eu bucket. Lots of GETs from EC2 IPs in us-east-1 between 02:00-04:30 UTC nightly. Query I used:

```sql
SELECT requestor, COUNT(*) as cnt, date_trunc('hour', from_iso8601_timestamp(requestdatetime)) as hr
FROM s3_access_logs
WHERE bucket = 'redwood-models-eu'
  AND operation = 'REST.GET.OBJECT'
  AND requestdatetime >= date '2026-02-01'
GROUP BY requestor, hr
ORDER BY hr
LIMIT 50;
```

Todd: The top requestor shows k8s-service-account:artifact-prewarm (namespace=prod-serving).

Anya: That matches the nightly model-prewarm job — it pulls full model tarballs from eu bucket to warm local caches in us-east. We designed it to reduce cold starts but it looks like it's pulling across regions. The job runs as a CronJob in cluster infra-us-east.

Sam: Confirmed in job logs: `artifact-prewarm: pulling model v12 from s3://redwood-models-eu/v12.tar.gz` every run, even when we already have it in us-east cache. There's also a fallback that uses signed URLs pointing at eu bucket. Logs: `GET https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-models-eu/v12.tar.gz 200 2.1GB` repeated ~1800 times last month.

Maria: So we have two separate egress sources: the model prewarm pulls and our centralized tracing/logs ingestion? Any traces routed cross-region?

Todd: Good call — our trace-collector had been forwarding full spans to the central APM in us-east for indexing. Sampling was low but volume combined with the prewarm pulls adds up. I pulled CloudWatch/VPC NAT metrics and NAT gateway data transfer out of eu-west-1 matches the S3 numbers.

Anya: Mitigation plan suggestions:
- Stop cross-region prewarm: change job to check for local bucket first (per-region buckets) and only pull if missing.
- Move artifact sync to a push model: when a model is published, replicate to us-east once (copy on publish) rather than pull-from-primary nightly.
- Enable S3 VPC Gateway endpoints in eu-west and us-east clusters to avoid NAT egress if any internal services were using internet path.
- Reduce full-span forwarding: switch to indexed-only span export and store raw traces in-region on cheaper storage for 7 days.

Sam: I'll open a PR to update the CronJob to short-circuit if local cache object exists and to add a `--prefer-local` flag to the prewarm tool. I can also disable the nightly prewarm for one week for testing.

Todd: I'll add a Cost Anomaly alert for cross-region DataTransfer-Out > 1TB/day and a daily Athena export of S3 logs into the cost-billing bucket. Also will run a one-off job to estimate monthly egress saved if we stop redundant pulls — rough calc: stopping prewarm pulls saves ~$9k/month, optimizing tracing saves ~$1.5k, replication cleanup ~$1k.

Maria: Please include the expected savings and rough rollout timeline in the PR so Finance can reforecast. If we can reduce ~$10k/mo it's material.

Anya: I'll also propose a short-term guard: modify artifact-publish pipeline to copy releases to region-specific buckets (`redwood-models-us-east`) on publish so reads are local. That costs a one-time replication egress per publish but avoids repeated pulls.

billing-bot: [automated] Cost anomaly detected: Cross-region DataTransfer-Out (eu-west-1 -> us-east-1) on prod-inference increased by 320% vs baseline on 2026-02-28. Alert ID: CA-2026-02-28-7.

Ian: Thanks all — next steps: Sam disables nightly prewarm and opens PR (+timeline), Anya updates publish pipeline, Todd sets alerts and runs final billing delta. Maria I'll ping you when PR has savings numbers. :thumbsup:

Maria: Sounds good. If anyone needs help with showback tags ping finance.

Sam: PR opened: https://git.internal.redwood/redwood/infra/+/MR-842 (adds --prefer-local, disables cron for 7d, adds instrumentation).

Anya: Filed infra ticket INF-309: add per-region artifact buckets + publish copy job.

Todd: Running Athena export now, will post CSV to #eng-finance in ~2h.

Ian: :+1:
